design: five department reviewers (compliance, statistics, reproducibility, research QA, public mirror), two board refuters per finding, a finding survives only if both decline to refute

confirmed_findings.title: Lingeling's licence forbids use in a commercial context; the audit and README narrow it to a shipping restriction and assert the use is 'evaluation and research' — a legal determination the section says it does not make, and not carried into the COULD NOT VERIFY list
The dataset card and the cold-clone instructions still say the Gutenberg sources are 'public-domain', the exact statement finding F1 found false for pg5200
§5.1 says the additional-terms grep 'matches only the translator line in both' copies; the banked copy has no translator line and the grep matches nothing there
The public mirror states that all four filtered GNSS files have unverifiable redistribution terms; the audit resolved the terms for the two BKG/IGS broadcast files
The updated consolidated COULD NOT VERIFY list drops a residual that §5.1 labels COULD NOT VERIFY: whether training on compressed windows of pg5200 is within §1.E.7 for a company
Depth-16 tree accuracy at 1024 misquoted: 0.1103 is the depth-8 tree; depth-16 is 0.1197
Heading says each halving of the window 'costs about the same'; the paragraph's own banked steps are 0.0504 and 0.0296
'CARVE_FAILS by 0.0025' quotes the slackest of three failed within-size clauses; the verdict-binding clauses miss by 0.0206 and 0.0192
'The same ordering as at 4096' is false: base64 and mixed swap places between 4096 and 2048
'Four incompressible families' counts gutenberg, which is Project Gutenberg English prose, not an incompressible generator
'60 findings' across two review rounds has no artifact in the repository — COULD NOT VERIFY
Prereg readings descriptor says corpus_b_chunk_offset 'must be >= 75000' while the sealed bar and the reader require exactly 75000
VERDICT attributes the 1024 depth-8 tree's accuracy (0.1103) to the depth-16 tree
CI determinism probe runs with zero source bytes, so the gutenberg family is silently replaced and never tested
The frozen reader does not check the cache's build metadata; the unfrozen script does
Training-time cost is banked as 4 cores while the engineering log says the run used 3 threads under nice
Coverage-map reverify commands for 0011 overwrite the banked artifacts they are meant to verify
fetch_sources.sh fallback URL is dead on HTTP errors and a 404 page is cached as the source
VERDICT quotes the depth-8 tree's 1024 accuracy as the depth-16 tree's
'A pass on csv and log masked by the incompressible families' is not supported on the reading it quotes
NARRATIVE reports 2048 only as 'fails by 0.0025' and never gives the stricter preregistered reading or the transfer margin
NARRATIVE says transfer 'collapses to chance at both' sizes; at 2048 the artifact does not support 'chance'
MILESTONES M3 cost extrapolation is contradicted by the banked 2048 cost it does not cite
'Two adversarial review rounds whose 60 findings' is not banked in any artifact and counts filed findings as accepted ones
'Each halving of the window costs about the same' is contradicted by the two banked steps it quotes
Per-family ordering at 2048 is not 'the same ordering as at 4096'
Evidence page's provenance stamp names a commit at which the artifacts it renders did not exist
Mirror note says each prereg/chain.jsonl entry carries a git_commit; no chain entry has that field
Banner and mirror note say all four GNSS files' redistribution terms could not be verified; the audit resolved two of them

rejected_titles: §5.4 attributes all four committed GNSS files and '5.5 MB' to commit b185129; that commit holds three files (4.4 MB), the fourth was committed earlier in 6ed8a6d
MANIFEST.json promises that committed source texts are 'marked', but no entry carries a mark and the committed IGS text (a pypdf extraction) has no recorded hash

Outbound documents quote the (2048, 4096] bracket without the top-rung caveat the verdict artifact attaches to it; the frozen-set miss is smaller than the slope-implied gain from matching 4096's 800000 rung
The scaling mutation gate never exercises fit(groups=...), the cluster branch every 0011 slope clause gates on
The logistic baseline that decides the 0.0025 near-miss did not converge, and no artifact or document says so
Per-family stricter margins are set beside the mixture's frozen-set miss as if they were the same reading
Mirror build has no post-filter verification; a future rebuild would silently publish a leaked item
disposition: every confirmed finding was fixed on 2026-09-03 and filed in CORRECTIONS.md; duplicates (the same defect reported by two departments) were fixed once
